rules: showcase.json: byte-identical except notice fields (checked separately as key+text)
api_surface.json: no public symbol disappears; renames must be listed in the wave report
errors.json: every name survives or maps to a documented replacement
cli.json: exit codes may change from 1 to the codes in plan section 3.4; messages become English

refreshed.why: showcase.json was captured on a locally regenerated showcase that never entered the index; hierarchy-index.json and the per-step split existed only on disk. recordings track the document corpus, which the plan edits changed. knowledge.json reflects the deliberate language split.

ten root documents moved to the sibling docs repository, which the Jarvis index also walks, so the corpus grew 1222 -> 1228 chunks and BM25 renormalised. Three recordings changed by 0.0001 in hit scores and by indexed_chunks; cited sources, their order and every answer text are byte-identical.

every one of the 226 keys was a pre-refactor module path (backend/application/**, backend/domain/**) that no longer exists, so the snapshot guarded nothing. Regenerated over the real tree (backend/shared, backend/contexts/**, backend/interfaces/**) with the original convention: ast.walk over the module, every non-underscore FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef/ClassDef at any nesting depth, sorted, modules without public symbols omitted. Verified by replaying the extractor against commit cda8c456, where it reproduces 225 of the 226 recorded entries exactly. Seven public symbols from the old surface are absent: Knowledge -> KnowledgeStore, shared_system_map and reset_shared_system_map -> the private _system_map cache in contexts/assistant/__init__.py, make_synthetic_artifact -> tests/support/backend/showcase_fixtures.py, commissioned -> a field of the Fund dataclass rather than a property, wells_file -> a method the old capture missed, LosslessEmitter -> removed with the legacy deck writer.
